create_NeuralSPJGenerator: create a NeuralSPJGenerator instance with a HuggingFace tokenizer and optional training augmentation settings
process_query_with_facts: process a query object with fact groups and update tokens to yield tokenized training instances
augment_training_with_negatives: augment training data by randomly injecting negative facts into fact groups to simulate false positives
prepend_prediction_type_answer: prepend a question type token like [COUNT] or [SET] to answer tokens for model output formatting
generate_test_instances_with_predicted_f: generate test instances using predicted facts from an IR system instead of ground truth facts
